- Build a complete, playable 2D point-and-click psychological horror game with Ward and Abyss realities, inventory puzzles, typewriter dialogue, and a creepy child/animal/shadow cast.

- Implement as a standalone HTML/CSS/SVG/JavaScript game in `index.html`, with no engine or external assets.
- Puzzle progression: collect the tin toy and Abyss-only red thread, combine into a humming toy, distract the shadow, take the bone key, unlock the cabinet, retrieve the glass heart, and return it to Moth.
